Facts: Liu was caught with 13 packages of white crystal-like substance, identified as heroin (海洛因). He possessed more than 10 grams (十克以上). The prosecution says he violated drug management regulations, possession of heroin over 10g, constituting 持有毒品罪 (possession of drug). In Chinese criminal law, the offense is "持有毒品罪". However there may be also "贩卖毒品罪" if he sold? He purchased from Peng, but not necessarily selling. The charge is possession. So single charge: 持有毒品罪.

Check the pattern: In earlier examples, they sometimes need multiple charges like "拐卖妇女、儿童". Here only one.

Thus final answer: [罪名]持有毒品罪<eoa>
